events.title: Demo Update — Combat and Farming Bug Fixes
events.summary: We’ve fixed several issues that could occur while playing the demo. Fixed an issue where enemies would stop instead of attacking a nearby target blocked by a wall. Fixed an issue where friendly government troops supporting the colony would select colony walls as targets during combat. Fixed a mismatch between line-of-fire checks and actual muzzle positions for colonists and NPCs at wall corners. events.title: Compartment alerts
events.summary: The top bar’s old Air leaks slot only counted cracked machines, so a breached room could still read “None”. It’s now Compartments: it tracks breaches, doors that open to the outside, and cracked facilities. Hover it for the list, click it to jump straight to the problem. events.title: MARSTEAD Is Joining Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46286657/9636f44245c0d13429a8ea9ad2f61019f4ad7ea9.png Play the MARSTEAD demo for free during Steam Next Fest. Build a settlement on Mars with your survivors and see if you can make it through the first 10 sols. We’ll keep improving the game based on your feedback as we work toward launch. If you enjoy MARSTEAD, please add it to your wishlist!

events.title: The MARSTEAD Demo Is Now Available
events.summary: The MARSTEAD demo is now available on Steam. You can play for free on Windows and macOS. Start a new settlement with three survivors and play through its first 10 sols—a sol is a Martian day. Build shelter, manage oxygen and water, set up electricity, and begin farming. You can save and load your progress, so you do not have to play through the demo in one sitting. You can also start a new settlement if you want to try a different approach. events.title: The MARSTEAD Demo Is Coming Soon!
events.summary: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46286657/349eccecc4a3b5db5df5383cf30b391dc4eeb10b.png Thank you for your patience—the MARSTEAD demo is almost here! You’ll be able to play MARSTEAD during Steam Next Fest this October. We’re adding support for German, Spanish (Spain), Portuguese (Brazil), Traditional Chinese, and Polish, so more players can enjoy MARSTEAD in their own language.
